occupation.name: Business Process Designer
occupation.description: Operating-model and process design for marketplace, tourism, crowdfunding, banking, and food-delivery domains.
responsibilities: Led the Business Process Designer team, translating complex client problems into comprehensive and actionable requirements.
Guided the UI/UX team, ensuring all design solutions and user experiences aligned with defined business requirements.
Collaborated with developers to ensure seamless integration of applications and business processes with the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system.
Implemented business processes efficiently by utilizing low-code tools to combine Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN), Decision Model and Notation (DMN), and REST API.
Designed an operating model based on the business models of the marketplace and tourism industries.
Developed functional requirements and accounting treatments for a Crowdfunding platform.
Created functional requirements for Core Banking and Loan Origination Systems.
Developed functional requirements, accounting treatments and wireframe for a money changer point of sales.
Facilitated the alignment of B2B tour and travel applications with business processes and requirements through the creation and rigorous testing of test cases.
Automated repetitive tasks using Python scripts.
occupation.skillsNote: BPMN, DMN, REST API, operating models, accounting treatments, test cases, Python automation.
